input.quote: 13.1 Subject to payment of applicable Fees, Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes and to provide services to Customer.
input.rationale: Section 13 satisfies the preferred position in full. 13.1 extends the subscription grant to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on their behalf (plus Authorized Users), with no "revocable" or "non-transferable" language. 13.2 grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence for paid-up software and Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables, including contractor support; 14.3 confirms that licence covers Vendor Technology required to use a Deliverable. 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor under Section 24 (24.1 allows M&A/asset-sale assignment without consent; 24.4 bars Vendor from terminating or suspending on our change of control) and limits revocation or suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure period, so the licence is not revocable at will. 13.4's use restrictions are ordinary and qualified ("knowingly", subject to Applicable Law, with carve-outs for authorized security testing and Customer Data/output) and do not cut back the grant. No redline needed.
